_comment: Delegations the founder gave in his own words. Each covers nothing until its decision record is accepted (scripts/lib/autonomy.ts evaluateDelegation). memory-fabric is never delegated. A delegated approval is recorded under minspec-sdd[bot], never the founder. See DR-108.
